$comment: Official XK Sans KR (Pretendard Variable KS X 1001 subset) consume copies. Owner is this repo. Every app keeps ONLY the ttf and LICENSE.txt at <app>/assets/fonts/xk_sans_kr (listed file by file in pubspec assets — never the directory) and the provenance at <app>/tactile_fonts.PROVENANCE.json, outside the asset tree, so no repo name or tool path ships as a public asset. Independent app-deploy copies are expected. Not a merge block.
